svg.aria-label: Availability board for 2026-09-20: a wall peg board with five rails, one per role (SP, RP, C, IF, OF), and one peg per player (28). Each peg carries a hanging tag: two bars means check in, one bar means watch, a ring means no change, a dashed ring means not enough data. A key rack at the right holds one sample of each tag. Fictional roster; not a fitness-to-play decision.
